items.title: Techniques for training large neural networks
items.summary: Large neural networks are at the core of many recent advances in AI, but training them is a difficult engineering and research challenge which requires orchestrating a cluster of GPUs to perform a single synchronized calculation.
items.summaryZh: 简要提及大规模神经网络训练是一项需要协调GPU集群的工程与研究挑战。
